title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(松本恵子研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Mastumoto Keiko)
keywords: Food Production Engineering 2.Plant Environmental Engineering 3.Plant biometry 4.Plant factories 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Utilizing sensing technology and information and information technology (ICT) as tools, we will elucidate the response characteristics of plants to the growing environment by clearly grasping the state of crops and growing environment. We aim to apply the obtained results to industries related to biological production. In this project activity, students start by discovering and setting "questions to be solved" and acquire scientific methods for solving "questions."
advice: In the previous semester, basic information on themes will be collected and preliminary experiments will be conducted. Acquire knowledge and usage of experimental equipment. After understanding the experimental plan, this experiment will be carried out independently. In the second semester, a project report with logical consistency will be created on the background and purpose of the project, the materials and methods of the experiment, results, and considerations. Learn how to write technical documents. In addition to the weekly seminars, we will promote research activities that emphasize real-life experiences through regional and international exchanges, joint research with companies, communication with farmers and agricultural production corporations, and field experiments. Organize a community consisting of local intellectual farming groups and retailers, and consider technology platforms and agricultural business models for the region.
requiredKnowledge: The themes dealt with in this laboratory are classified into plant production engineering, and “fields of biological production'' such as agriculture are mainly assumed as the exit of industrial application. Therefore, it is desirable to have a wide-ranging intellectual curiosity and a basic understanding of measurement engineering, statistics, biology, physics, and chemistry.

activityGoals.body: To collect basic knowledge on project themes.
To understand the experimental design on the project theme.
To understand the measurement principle of the experimental equipment on the project theme.
The experimental results can be considered scientifically, logically and an easy-to-understand.

achievementLevels.ideal: In addition to the items described in the Standard Level of Achievement Guidelines, you should be able to do the following. (1) Organize the achievements and remaining issues of existing technologies related to the theme. (2) Be able to develop a reasonable experimental design. (3) Perform experimental operations accurately and quickly.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Gather basic knowledge on the theme. (2) Understand the experimental plan related to the theme. (3) Understand the measurement principles of experimental equipment related to the theme and be able to perform experimental operations. (4) Be able to consider the results of experiments scientifically and logically, and be able to explain the research results to a third party in an easy-to-understand manner as a paper or oral presentation.
